description: Read the full indexed text of one citation from the "heldfast-churn-placeholder" knowledge base: the cited chunk plus up to 3 neighbouring chunks on each side, within the output budget. Use it after ragmir_search to quote or verify a passage before relying on it. To read a whole document, expand the returned nextCitation (or previousCitation) with the same contextRadius until it is absent; documentChunks counts the document's chunks. Pass citations (up to 5) instead of citation to read several in one output budget. Read-only; reports found:false when the citation is no longer in the index, with suggestedCitation (the nearest passage of a document still indexed) or similarPaths (indexed files with a close name) to try instead.

citation.description: A citation from ragmir_search, such as docs/runbook.md:L12-L18#4 or specs/brief.pdf:p3#2.

citations.description: Instead of citation: up to 5 citations read together in one output budget.

contextRadius.description: Neighbouring chunks to include on each side, 0 to 3.

expectedEvidenceId.description: The evidence id ragmir_search returned with that citation. If the indexed passage has changed since, the call fails with EVIDENCE_CHANGED instead of returning other text.

maxBytes.description: Output budget in bytes for this call; the server caps it at its configured maximum.

name: ragmir_expand
title: Ragmir expand: heldfast-churn-placeholder
